4.6.5 Ignoring Execution Order
In the context of logical execution time it is necessary to specify the execution order of executable entities at a later point in time than the point in time the executable entities are mapped to LET intervals. Since the purpose of the execution order constraint is to specify an execution order among a number of given executable entities, it is required to indicate that the executable entities referenced within an execution order constraint are not ordered yet or the order is not relevant. Indeed, later in the development of a system the execution order becomes relevant. For this purpose the optional attribute ignoreOrderAllowed is added to the ExecutionOrderConstraint to indicate that the given order shall/could be ignored. The type of this attribute is boolean: The value FALSE indicates to take the specified order into account; and the value TRUE indicates to ignore the given order. Please note that the execution order is either specified by the successor relationships or the fact that the list nestedElement is an ordered list of elements.
